title: Las dificultades de la transición
goal: Read how Serrano's attempted move in Guatemala failed without his army's firm backing, and how crises in Brazil, Ecuador and Argentina were resolved through civil and constitutional channels.

items: State what risk Serrano ran by acting without his army's firm backing.
Describe how Brazil's "caras pintadas" pushed Congress to remove Collor.
Describe the falls of Bucaram and Mahuad in Ecuador and of De la Rúa in Argentina.
Explain how these crises were channelled through civil and constitutional routes.
